c_voss_intro.text: Eleven years I've watched that water. I know where it's kind, and where it isn't.

c_voss_build.text: Tighter. Let the plank tell you where it wants to go.

c_voss_launch.text: Row, lad. And don't look back at it.

c_kessel.text: Busy hands, friend. The governor likes to hear about busy hands.

c_warder_beam.text: Who's on the wall? Show yourself!

c_warder_sea.text: There! Light on the sail! Man the boat!

c_warder_transfer.text: On your feet. The boat won't wait.

c_foreman_planks.text: Seven lids yesterday. Six today. Funny, that.

c_foreman_tools.text: Every tool back on its hook by the bell.

c_laundress.text: Mail sacks don't walk off on their own, dearie.

c_governor.text: I have read your file all week. Take him below.
